class.name: OcgShapefixSplittool
class.brief_description: Tool for splitting and cutting edges; includes methods used in OverlappingTool and IntersectionTool
class.description: ! Tool for splitting and cutting edges; includes methods ! used in OverlappingTool and IntersectionTool

method.name: SplitEdge_1
method.description: Split edge on two new edges using new vertex "vert" and "param" - parameter for splitting The "face" is necessary for pcurves and using TransferParameterProj

method.name: SplitEdge_2
method.description: Split edge on two new edges using new vertex "vert" and "param1" and "param2" - parameter for splitting and cutting The "face" is necessary for pcurves and using TransferParameterProj

method.name: CutEdge
method.description: Cut edge by parameters pend and cut

method.name: SplitEdge_3
method.description: Split edge on two new edges using two new vertex V1 and V2 and two parameters for splitting - fp and lp correspondingly The "face" is necessary for pcurves and using TransferParameterProj aNum - number of edge in SeqE which corresponding to [fp,lp]
